sentences.zh: 四年，攻破橋頭里賊壘，又破賊於孟家莊，殲城外賊殆盡。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he stormed the rebel stockade at Qiaotouli, again defeated rebels at Mengjiazhuang, and annihilated nearly all the rebels outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1865), he stormed the camp at Qiaotouli, routed the enemy at Mengjiazhuang, and all but wiped out the rebels outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 穴地破城，輝武先登，擒賊目蔡四。

translations.literal: By tunneling he breached the city; Huiwu was first to scale the wall and captured the rebel officer Cai Si.
translations.idiomatic: When mining brought down the wall, Huiwu was first over the breach and seized the rebel officer Cai Si.

sentences.zh: 巡部，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: He inspected the troops and was recorded by name for major general.
translations.idiomatic: After inspecting the ranks, he was placed on the register for major general.

sentences.zh: 從討松潘叛番，拔其巢。

translations.literal: He followed in campaigning against rebellious Tibetans in Songpan and uprooted their nest.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against the Tibetan rebels in Songpan and destroyed their stronghold.

sentences.zh: 尋攻黑河番，焚芝麻第五寨，餘寨皆降。

translations.literal: Soon after he attacked the Heihe tribes, burned the fifth stockade at Zhima, and the remaining stockades all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: He next struck the Heihe tribes, burned the fifth stockade at Zhima, and the rest submitted.

sentences.zh: 乘勝連破大松樹及竹自三寨，以提督記名。

translations.literal: Riding the victory, he in succession captured Dasongshu and the three stockades of Zhuzi, and was recorded by name for provincial commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the advantage, he took Dasongshu and the three Zhuzi stockades in turn and was placed on the register for provincial commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六年，捻匪竄陝西，輝武率步隊五營赴援，剿破汧陽、隴州、寶雞諸賊，西路肅清。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Nian rebels fled into Shaanxi; Huiwu led five battalions of infantry to relieve them, suppressed and broke rebels at Qianyang, Longzhou, Baoji, and elsewhere, and the western route was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1867), when Nian rebels crossed into Shaanxi, Huiwu marched five infantry battalions to their relief, broke the enemy at Qianyang, Longzhou, Baoji, and neighboring districts, and cleared the western front.

sentences.zh: 八年，剿董志原竄匪，斃賊目王明章，晉號福凌阿巴圖魯，授漢中鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he suppressed Nian rebels who had fled to Dongzhiyuan, killed the rebel officer Wang Mingzhang, had his title advanced to Fuling'a Batulu, and was appointed major general of the Hanzhong Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1869), he hunted Nian bands at Dongzhiyuan, killed the rebel officer Wang Mingzhang, received an advancement of his title to Fuling'a Batulu, and was appointed major general of the Hanzhong garrison.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕提督劉端冕分擊北山回匪，破翟三、禹得彥於縣頭鎮、陳村。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, together with Provincial Commander Liu Duanmian he divided forces to strike the Hui rebels of Beishan and defeated Zhai San and Yu Deyan at Xiantou Town and Chencun.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1870), he and Provincial Commander Liu Duanmian split their forces against the Muslim rebels of the northern hills and routed Zhai San and Yu Deyan at Xiantou Town and Chencun.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢甘肅提督，仍留防漢中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was promoted to provincial commander-in-chief of Gansu but still remained to defend Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1872), he was promoted to provincial commander-in-chief of Gansu but stayed on to guard Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年，卒，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu, he died; condolence gifts were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Guangxu (1878), he died, and the court granted mourning favors.

sentences.zh: 輝武在漢中久，軍民相安。

translations.literal: Huiwu was long in Hanzhong, and soldiers and civilians lived in mutual peace.
translations.idiomatic: Huiwu's long tenure at Hanzhong kept the army and the people at ease with one another.

sentences.zh: 疏濬府城東河道達漢川，旁引溝渠以資灌溉，民食其利；

translations.literal: He dredged the eastern river channel of the prefectural city to reach Han River, drew side canals beside it to supply irrigation, and the people enjoyed its benefit;
translations.idiomatic: He dredged the eastern channel below the prefectural seat so it reached the Han River, cut feeder canals for irrigation, and the people reaped the benefit;

sentences.zh: 又修復褎斜棧道，商旅便焉。

translations.literal: He also restored the Baoxie plank road, to the convenience of merchants and travelers.
translations.idiomatic: he also restored the Baoxie plank road, which eased travel for merchants and couriers alike.

sentences.zh: 沒後，士民籥請建祠，從之。

translations.literal: After his death, gentry and commoners jointly petitioned to build a shrine, and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: After his death the local gentry and populace petitioned for a shrine, and the court assented.

sentences.zh: 唐友耕，雲南大關廳人。

translations.literal: Tang Yougeng was a native of Daguan Subprefecture in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yougeng came from Daguan in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，滇匪起，陷賊，至四川敘州，自拔來歸。

translations.literal: During the Xianfeng reign Yunnan rebels rose; he fell into their hands, reached Xuzhou in Sichuan, and escaped to return to the government side.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xianfeng era, when Yunnan rebels rose, he was captured by them; reaching Xuzhou in Sichuan, he broke free and came over to the Qing side.

sentences.zh: 從戰有功，授千總，署通江營守備。

translations.literal: Following in battle he had merit and was appointed company commander, acting as garrison commandant of the Tongjiang Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Merit in subsequent fighting won him appointment as company commander and acting commandant of the Tongjiang garrison.

sentences.zh: 賊擾​​鹽井，屢從戰擊走之，擢守備。

translations.literal: When rebels harassed the Salt Wells, he repeatedly followed in battle to drive them off and was promoted to garrison commandant.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels raided the Salt Wells, he fought them off again and again and was promoted to garrison commandant.

sentences.zh: 十年，戰峨眉索橋，受傷，破賊雙福場，進平天全茅山賊壘，擢都司，賜號額勒莫克依巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he fought at Suoqiao in Emei, was wounded, defeated rebels at Shuangfu Chang, advanced to pacify the rebel stockade at Maoshan in Tianquan, was promoted to battalion commander, and granted the title Elemokei Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1860), he fought at Suoqiao near Emei, was wounded, routed the enemy at Shuangfu Field, advanced to clear the Maoshan camp in Tianquan, was made battalion commander, and received the title Elemokei Batulu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，援潼川，破賊解圍，擢副將。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he relieved Tongchuan, defeated rebels and raised the siege, and was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1861), he marched to relieve Tongchuan, broke the siege, and was promoted to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 駱秉章督師至蜀，檄友耕會諸軍援綿州，令自石橋鋪進攻，友耕觀望不前，被劾，褫職留營。

translations.literal: When Luo Bingzhang took command in Shu, he ordered Yougeng to join the armies in relieving Mianzhou and to advance from Shiqiaopu; Yougeng hesitated and did not advance, was impeached, stripped of office but kept with the camp.
translations.idiomatic: When Luo Bingzhang took command in Sichuan, he summoned Yougeng to join the relief of Mianzhou and attack from Shiqiaopu; Yougeng hung back, was impeached, stripped of rank but kept with the army.

sentences.zh: 既而會援眉州，友耕軍先至，戰比有功，圍解，復原官。

translations.literal: Soon after he joined in relieving Meizhou; Yougeng's army arrived first, fought with repeated merit, the siege was raised, and his original office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: He then took part in relieving Meizhou; Yougeng's troops arrived first, fought well, lifted the siege, and his former rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 戰青神，陣斬賊目張興，身被二傷，裹創力戰，賊大敗。

translations.literal: At Qing Shen he slew in battle the rebel officer Zhang Xing, himself received two wounds, bound his wounds and fought on with force, and the rebels were greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingshen he killed the rebel officer Zhang Xing in the field, took two wounds, bound them and kept fighting, and routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，破石達開黨賴裕新於工卩州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, he defeated Lai Yuxin, a partisan of Shi Dakai, at Gongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first Tongzhi year (1862), he defeated Lai Yuxin, a lieutenant of Shi Dakai, at Gong County.

sentences.zh: 三月，達開圍涪州，友耕馳援，解其圍，授四川重慶鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the third month, Dakai besieged Fuzhou; Yougeng rushed to relieve it and raised the siege; he was appointed major general of the Chongqing Garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, when Dakai besieged Fuzhou, Yougeng raced to the relief, broke the siege, and was appointed major general of the Chongqing garrison.

sentences.zh: 會諸軍复長寧，賊引去。

translations.literal: He joined the armies in recovering Changning, and the rebels withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined the allied forces in retaking Changning, and the rebels withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，達開屯敘州雙龍場，分黨屯橫江，友耕攻破江岸賊壘。

translations.literal: That winter Dakai encamped at Shuanglongchang in Xuzhou and divided his party to camp at Hengjiang; Yougeng stormed the rebel stockades on the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Dakai held Shuanglong Field in Xuzhou and detached a column at Hengjiang; Yougeng stormed the riverbank camps.

sentences.zh: 二年春，賊由橫江竄新灘溪，與屏山隔一水，友耕慮賊乘間偷渡，乃濟江設伏，誘賊深入，敗之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, rebels fled from Hengjiang to Xintanxi, separated from Pingshan by one stretch of water; Yougeng feared the rebels would seize an interval to cross secretly, so he crossed the river and set an ambush, lured the rebels deep in, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year (1863), the rebels slipped from Hengjiang to Xintan Creek, a river away from Pingshan; fearing a night crossing, Yougeng forded the river, laid an ambush, drew them in, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 六月，達開謀渡金沙江，官軍扼之不得進，改趨天全土司地，友耕擊沉賊筏；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Dakai planned to cross the Jinsha River; government troops blocked him so he could not advance, changed course toward the tusi territory of Tianquan, and Yougeng sank the rebel rafts;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, when Dakai tried to cross the Jinsha, government troops blocked him; he turned toward the Tianquan tusi lands, and Yougeng sank his rafts;

sentences.zh: 達開奔老鴉漩，復為土兵所遏，遂就擒。

translations.literal: Dakai fled to Laoyaxuan, was again blocked by native troops, and was thus captured.
translations.idiomatic: Dakai fled to Laoyaxuan, was stopped by local militia, and was taken.

sentences.zh: 友耕擢雲南提督，留屯川南。

translations.literal: Yougeng was promoted to provincial commander-in-chief of Yunnan and remained garrisoned in southern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yougeng was promoted to provincial commander-in-chief of Yunnan but remained on garrison duty in southern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 四年，丁母憂，詔改署提督，友耕請終制，許之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he entered mourning for his mother; an edict changed his post to acting provincial commander-in-chief; Yougeng requested to complete the mourning period, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1865), upon his mother's death, the court named him acting provincial commander-in-chief; Yougeng asked to observe full mourning, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 七年服闋，署四川總督崇實奏緩陛見，令募勇防川北。

translations.literal: In the seventh year his mourning ended; Acting Governor of Sichuan Chong Shi memorialized to defer his audience at court and ordered him to recruit braves to guard northern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended in the seventh year (1868), Acting Sichuan Governor Chong Shi asked the court to defer his capital audience and set him to raising troops for the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 八年，調赴雲南，招降回寇李本忠等，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was transferred to Yunnan, induced the surrender of the Hui bandit Li Benzhong and others, and was granted the yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1869), he was transferred to Yunnan, accepted the surrender of the Muslim rebel Li Benzhong and others, and received the yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，署四川提督，八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu, he acted as provincial commander-in-chief of Sichuan; in the eighth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Guangxu (1880), he served as acting provincial commander-in-chief of Sichuan; in the eighth year (1882), he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：雷正綰、陶茂林、曹克忠皆多隆阿部下戰將。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Lei Zhengwan, Tao Maolin, and Cao Kezhong were all battle generals under Duolong'a.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Lei Zhengwan, Tao Maolin, and Cao Kezhong were all field commanders who had served under Duolong'a.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿歿後，甘肅軍事實倚三人，以餉匱兵變，遂難成功。

translations.literal: After Duolong'a's death, Gansu military affairs in fact relied on the three men, but because pay was exhausted and troops mutinied, success was therefore hard to achieve.
translations.idiomatic: After Duolong'a died, Gansu strategy rested on the three of them, yet empty coffers and mutiny made victory elusive.

sentences.zh: 克忠較有謀略，其軍獨全，終以病引退，後猶稱為宿將。

translations.literal: Kezhong was comparatively endowed with strategy; his army alone remained intact; in the end he withdrew on grounds of illness, yet afterward he was still called a veteran general.
translations.idiomatic: Kezhong was the more resourceful; his command alone came through intact; he eventually retired on account of illness, yet men still spoke of him as a veteran.

sentences.zh: 胡中和、周達武等皆以楚軍平蜀寇。

translations.literal: Hu Zhonghe, Zhou Dawu, and others all used the Chu army to pacify the Shu rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zhonghe, Zhou Dawu, and their fellows pacified Sichuan with Hunan armies.

sentences.zh: 唐友耕以蜀軍頡頏其間，並躋專閫。

translations.literal: Tang Yougeng, with a Shu army, held his own among them and likewise rose to independent provincial command.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yougeng, leading Sichuan troops, held his own in that company and likewise rose to independent provincial command.

sentences.zh: 達武晚任貴州軍事，與席寶田同定苗疆，建樹較閎達焉。

translations.literal: Dawu in his later years held Guizhou military affairs; together with Xi Baotian he pacified the Miao frontier, and his achievements were comparatively grand and far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: Dawu's later career in Guizhou, where he and Xi Baotian together settled the Miao frontier, stands as the broadest achievement among them.
